'''Haerm, General '''is commander of the [[Illianer Companions]] in the Last Battle replacing [[Demetre Marcolin]] who got killed by Sharan assault on the plains of Kandor.{{Ref|{{twotc}}, Haerm, General}}

== Activities ==
Haerm fights with the Illianer Companions in the [[Aes Sedai]] army at [[Kandor]]. After the army is routed by the [[Shara]]ns, he report that [[Egwene al'Vere]] is still missing.

== Trivia ==
* Haerm is named for Harm Wieringa, a fan of ''The Wheel of Time''.<ref name="thirteenth-depository">Taglieri, Linda. [http://13depository.blogspot.com/2002/02/character-names-derived-from-readers.html Character Names Derived From Readers' Names]</ref>
